answer: Each identity leases one distinct farmers-market stall, its cedar counter numbered on a basalt marker set in the shale lane, and must staff it in person selling real goods 6 hours every Saturday, manager-logged. 1,000 Sybils need 1,000 stalls at $80 weekly rent ($320,000 monthly), 1,000 distinct operators for simultaneous Saturdays, stock costs, and lose a 5-coin bond per missed, shared or vacant stall.
